sql.permission.getUserPermissions: select p.permission_name from flow.user_role ur inner join flow.role r on r.id = ur.role_id inner join flow.role_permission rp on rp.role_id = r.id inner join flow.company_permission cp on cp.id = rp.company_permission_id inner join flow.permission p on p.id = cp.permission_id where ur.user_id = :userId AND r.archived is not true and p.archived is not true and cp.company_id = :companyId group by p.permission_name
sql.permission.getAllForCompany: select p.id, p.permission_name, p.archived, p.permission_code from flow.permission p inner join flow.company_permission cp on cp.permission_id = p.id where cp.company_id = :companyId and p.archived is not true order by p.permission_name
sql.permission.getOne: select p.id, p.permission_name, p.archived from flow.company_permission p where p.id = :id
sql.permission.updatePermission: update flow.company_permission set permission_name = :permissionName where id = :id
